scratchWrapper:
python3() {

     [[ "$1" == -m && "${2:-}" == unittest && "${5:-}" == tools/deterministic-scheduling/tests ]]; then
    TMPDIR="$MIRRORS_REVIEW_RAM_SCRATCH" command python3 "$@"

  fi
